name: Aston Martin Ulster
description: The Aston Martin Ulster (1934-1936) was a lightweight racing version of the Le Mans model, featuring a 1.5-liter inline-4 engine producing 85 bhp at 5250 rpm. Named after its success in the 1934 Ulster TT race, where it finished 3rd, 4th, and 5th, the Ulster became one of Aston Martin's most celebrated pre-war racing cars. Its advanced twin-cam engine, lightweight construction, and impressive handling made it competitive against much larger machinery.
author: Ex-Mods / ACTK
